parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are largely undocumented rather than documented as enforced. There is no trans-specific offence, no documented border or document friction, and no facility or custody birth-sex rule in the record. Sexuality law was decriminalised in 2022, so criminal exposure is low. Against this, the only violence record is one 2018 attack with a no-jail sentence in 2019, an impunity outcome but a single dated case with no later instance. Official and religious rhetoric is hostile, though it is not shown to be enforced against visitors. Employment exclusion is resident-facing and carries little weight. Visible civil society (vigils, Pride events) is a climate signal only. Custody, healthcare and emergency-care practice are undocumented and treated as open questions. Overall this sits in the elevated band: the impunity record and hostile official rhetoric subtract from an otherwise non-criminalising, non-exclusionary picture.
